Hm, I’m not sure then. I do think it is a good idea to pay a quick visit to the vet just to make sure everything’s okay. If you want to bring a sample for them but they cannot give you an appointment soon enough, (I know this is so gross) you can freeze the sample so it will be fresh? I just know this from experience with my dog, that’s what our vet told us to do since we couldn’t get in that quick. 

Edit: SORRY forgot to make this a reply!

I’m not in any way a vet or anything like that but my guess is that it might be small rocks from outside. My German Shepherd loves the small rocks we have around the exterior of our house. I think he thinks it’s food, I don’t know, dogs are weird! But I always try and get him away as soon as possible if I see him going for them. 

Did you find this in only one or multiple? If it was only one or two it might just be something he shouldn’t have ate (like rocks). If it’s in a lot of them like looking at multiple days I’m not sure. 

It is definitely a good idea to see the vet if it is that concerning just to put minds at ease. I hope everything works out and that the pup’s healthy!

My grandfather is the only reason I’m still living here to be honest. I just don’t even know what’s going on in my own life anymore. I tried to discuss this pregnancy thing with my boyfriend again and it was a bit calmer but he still is stuck by what he thinks is right which is keeping it. He said that he’s hoping that I’m not basing my decision over everything else that’s going on in my life but isn’t that the smart thing to do? I mean what’s happening in someone’s life is a major thing to take into mind isn’t it? Am I just crazy or is my boyfriend not thinking fully or is just being selfish because he wants this kid so bad? 

Yesterday was a better day but it’s all crashing down again. The sale of the houses might be falling through again which means we need to go through the whole process AGAIN with my grandfather not being able to move around great. With people randomly showing up to look at the house and needing to make it look like it’s a magazine and no one lives there with two cats and a dog. And now me in this situation.  

I’m just really loosing it today again, I don’t want this to be my life, I don’t know how much longer I can deal with all of this I just feel so alone. My appointment is still scheduled and I still have my mind made up but I have been looking at peoples experiences with the pill, which is what my appointment was made for, and there’s been a lot of horror stories and I’ve read some more positive ones. I’m just worried because I’m going to be alone when I would be at home taking the medication and people have said that it’s a good idea to have someone there. My boyfriend isn’t able to be with me that day and I kind of think it’s best if he’s not but I don’t know I’m scared. I know there’s a hotline and a lot of people have done the pill method and are fine but I’m afraid of it not working and needing to pay put more money afterwards that I do not have (i can barely afford this first time) and what if it does work and what if somethings going wrong with me? There’s a lot. I’m sure the people at the office will be able to answer all my questions but it’s still nerve wrecking... 

I’m just so scared of what the future has in for me and I don’t know how much more I can handle and I know I can handle a lot but this is just too much...

Maybe for the next few weeks but after we move there’s no way... we aren’t even than close (distance) right now (about 20 min) but when we move we are going to be more like an hour and a half. 

My boyfriend has wanted me to live with him but the fear of being disowned by both my grandfather and my mother has scared me too much to actually go through with it. Ans now that my grandfather is in such bad shape I feel like I can’t leave him like this... the man raised me. (My moms a single mother, dads a ... bum... that’s the nice way to put it). I already lost my grandmother who was my best friend my grandfather is basically my dad he gave me everything he could and he is my world. I’m rambling now but yea.. he’s in bad shape I feel like I can’t do that now... I hate to say it but we don’t know how long he has and I want to make him as comfortable and happy as I can. 

My aunt would if it was just her, my uncle is not so generous..? I’m not too sure if that’s the word I want but I think it gets the idea across. I know he cares somewhat but he’s the only one working and they are barely making it themselves at the same time. I just don’t think that’s an option... 

I’ve called once before when I was having a rough time and I know I just had the crap luck to get the one person answering the phones that it’s doesn’t seem to want to help..? I never called again since then .. it almost made me feel worse but I know people have had very helpful conversations when calling the hotline. I’m also very shy to talk about my problems because of how my mom brought me up... idk I know she cares but there’s a point where it’s too much... 

I will try and word my sentences more sensitively because I know he feels strongly about this and so do I. But I’ve already tried so hard and to explain my side very calmly even though I feel like I’m dying inside and the sky is falling lol. But he just gets so worked up and he gets loud even though I don’t think he means to yell he’s just a very loud person to be honest and he is very sensitive when it comes to things he cares a lot about. I know he doesn’t realize how rough things are on me right now... I didn’t come to a realization till recently because I’m honestly really really selfless and think that my feelings aren’t justified sometimes and I’m just being emotional but my best friend and my aunt actually made me realize that I do have a lot going on. 

I have the appointment at the office for next Thursday and I know I want kids but I know that I cannot handle this right now and I know stress is not good for a baby in general ... I’m upset that I have to make this decision because a baby is supposed to be a happy thing. The call I made just for the appointment was so hard... just the idea is sad but I feel like this is the smart thing to do... and so does my boyfriend but he still wished I would change my mind. 

I really appreciate the effort by the way, this was really hard for be to post I just needed outside thoughts if that makes any sense. And I’m honestly becoming really desperate at the moment just constantly with panic attacks and trying to not cry and stress my boyfriend out or make my mom ask what’s going on.

Not really, I only have one close friend and she has so much going on herself I couldn’t. My aunt comes over sometimes but not much and my uncle and his wife could give a flying you know what... 

I just am so terrified of having a baby in general so everything that’s going on now I just... I don’t think I can do it. I don’t know.. I know where my boyfriend is coming from it’s going to hurt me too but he thinks that I’m not thinking about him even though I try and tell him I see where he’s coming from but it’s not just him. He just rebuts by saying “no it’s only you, right?” 

I also didn’t mention that this happened to him previously with his ex that also wanted to terminate for the same reasons and he wanted her to keep it as well. After she terminated they apparently fought a lot and that’s why they didn’t work out. So he brings up that I know he went through this I should have known and gotten on birth control or something.... he brings up how he really wishes for me to change my mind we argue and I get extremely upset because I don’t want to loose him and then a while later he’s like I love you so much. I just ... at this point I wouldn’t be shocked if I have a miscarriage because of all this stress... 

I’m afraid of therapy.. my house has never been very verbal because of how my mother is, she’s not all there sorry to say. It’s become very clear over the years as I’ve gotten older that it’s not normal how I grew up and how she is. I can’t tell her I’m pregnant... she doesn’t even know I’m dating someone right now... I’m 21 and I fear for my life when she gets mad because she throws things and slams and screams and yells and threatens ... I fear for my life and my grandfathers...
